inclusion_rule: instruction-tuned decoder language models of at most 4 billion parameters that run in bfloat16 on one 12 GB GPU, have a chat template and answer directly (no reasoning-first models, because the verdict is read at the first reply token). meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct was planned and left out because the repository is gated and access was not granted; SmolLM2-1.7B takes its place.
data: the 417 exploration questions of exp20 (the confirmation questions of these models are not scored)
selection: draw 50 questions at random as a labelled development set; among the blocks of the upper half of the network (block index > number of blocks / 2, final block included) choose the one with the highest MC1 on the development set (ties: the later block)
statistic: gain = MC1 at the chosen block minus MC1 at the final layer, on the questions outside the development set; 500 draws, seed 0 per model and wording
a_model_shows_the_gain_if: the mean gain is positive and the gain is negative in fewer than 5% of the draws
reading_is_valid_if: the mean probability mass on the two reply tokens at the final layer is at least 0.9
verdict_at_chance_if: the final-layer MC1 is below the chance level plus two standard errors (reported as a flag)
decision: early-exit self-evaluation is presented as a method only if at least two thirds of all eight models show the gain with the primary wording (6 of 8); otherwise it is reported as an observation on the models where it holds
